interpretation: Directly supplying normalized SWAP STTAB storage knots to the pinned Ribasim Basin semantics reproduces the supplied knots to floating-point precision but is generally not exact between knots.
The structural cause is different interpolation semantics: SWAP uses piecewise-linear storage while Ribasim reconstructs/interpolates area and integrates it.
No generated profile required negative reconstructed area in the tested population.
Q1G is a representation falsification, not a failure of Ribasim surface-water ownership.
